svg.title: Question-first method selection for the CREBAIN categorical MGW study
svg.desc: Publication diagram that separates four question-first lanes and eighteen typed method objects. Normalized innovation squared assesses per-channel innovation magnitude. A two-arm CUSUM is a separate operational diagnostic. Its lower arm is inert on the fusion core's degrees-of-freedom-three route. Other admitted degrees of freedom retain the general recurrence. Signed Pearson correlation assesses directional linear agreement. None of these three operational diagnostics is evaluated by this fixture. KSG estimates general pairwise continuous dependence, including nonlinear dependence, when its declared support and row assumptions hold. Mutual information is direction-free with respect to correlation sign. KSG is not a PID. KSG is inapplicable to this repeated atomic categorical fixture. Categorical Makkeh-Gutknecht-Wibral shared-exclusions PID is produced because the study fixes ordered categorical sources, a named latent-truth target, and complete raw rows. The matrix separates five selected categorical objects. The paper functional is functional.shared-exclusions.mgw-categorical. The raw-row empirical-PMF sample-estimator route is route.shared-exclusions.mgw-empirical-pmf. The upstream implementation-method catalog identity is shared-exclusions.categorical. The concrete entry points are pid_core::stable::categorical::discrete_sxpid2_with_budget and pid_core::stable::categorical::discrete_sxpid3_with_budget. Raw rows produce a plug-in empirical-PMF estimate. They do not evaluate a separately declared population law. Exact cell balance makes the empirical PMF coincide with the canonical law for this fixture only. The primary PID2 chart uses a zero to 0.45 nat scale. This domain contains the largest value of 0.405465 nats. The chart shows informative, misinformative, and signed net components for redundancy, unique visual, unique radar, and synergy. The full eligibility matrix also keeps Williams-Beer I-min, two-source-only BROJA, the Schick-Poland general construction, the continuous Ehrlich functional, the Ehrlich nearest-neighbor estimator, pairwise KSG mutual information, co-information, O-information, normalized innovation squared, the two-arm CUSUM, signed correlation, and the PNAS and ICLR infomorphic objective compositions separate. Only the five selected categorical-chain objects have produced status. Concrete PID output is emitted through the two exact entry points. PID3 remains exploratory. It does not close the separate 108-coordinate averaged cumulative-plus-atom assurance program. The dependency-disjoint Decimal route compares 66 averaged atom components only. Asymmetric PID2 and PID3 canaries protect source order. All output remains record-only advisory evidence with no edge to FusedVerdict or Haldir policy.
svg.text: Choose the scientific object from the question—not from a method hierarchy
The four lanes are parallel. An unavailable object never triggers a fallback into a different estimand.
Two-arm CUSUM: fusion-core dof=3 lower arm is inert.
Separate diagnostics. Neither is evaluated by this fixture.
Did expected positive linear agreement change?
Direction is retained · common projection and lifecycle contract · operational lane
No correlation result is inferred from the PID fixture or from its favorable atoms.
Is an eligible continuous pair generally dependent?
General dependence, including nonlinear structure · direction-free · not PID
Repeated atomic rows violate this route. Added noise would change the estimand.
How is information about one target allocated?
Use a named PID functional on a fixed source–target estimand.
Here: categorical MGW · ordered sources · latent-truth target · raw rows → empirical PMF
This is a sample estimate. Exact-law coincidence is limited to this balanced fixture.
2 · PRIMARY PID2 RESULT · HORIZONTAL INCURSION · NATURAL-LOG UNITS
V = visual north-plane crossing · R = radar east-plane crossing · T_H = V ∧ R from synthetic latent ENU truth
MGW adds a target-specific allocation that
pairwise or joint association alone does not provide.
It does not establish causation, trust, attack intent,
fault responsibility, calibration, or permission to act.
Source order is protected by asymmetric PID2 and PID3
named-field canaries, not by symmetry or labels alone.
Pointwise values are retained but not independently compared.
Scale maximum = 0.45 nats. The largest bar, ln(3/2) = 0.405465…, is inside the plotted domain.
3 · EIGHTEEN DISTINCT OBJECTS IN THE TYPED ELIGIBILITY MATRIX
Status applies only here. Functional, sample-estimator route, implementation method, entry point, estimator, diagnostic, and objective stay distinct.
Paper-defined pointwise cumulatives and Möbius atoms.
The functional does not identify a sample route or software entry point.
Raw rows form a plug-in empirical PMF before functional evaluation.
This is sample estimation, not evaluation of a declared population law.
Upstream method-catalog identity for categorical sample estimation.
It is neither the paper-functional ID nor Galadriel's route ID.
Ordered (V,R), T_H · explicit budget · pointwise and averaged atoms.
Ordered (V,R,A), T_V · 18 atoms. The 108-coordinate program stays open.
Different redundancy functional and atom allocation.
Comparator only. A shared lattice does not make it an MGW alias.
External constrained-distribution comparator for PID2 only.
Separate solver provenance. No three-source BROJA route is implied.
Neither MGW nor Ehrlich is treated as its alias or umbrella.
Distinct continuous estimand at a fixed source gauge.
No absolutely continuous law is declared for these atomic rows.
Estimator identity is separate from the Ehrlich functional.
Atomic support abstains. No added-noise or quantization repair.
General pairwise continuous dependence · direction-free · not PID.
Repeated categorical support violates the declared route.
Signed interaction invariant under a declared convention.
It is not a redundancy, unique-information, or synergy atom.
It does not allocate redundancy-lattice atoms.
No lifecycle-qualified NIS report is produced here.
Sequential accumulator. Fusion-core dof=3 lower arm is inert.
Distinct from NIS. No lifecycle-qualified state or alarm is produced here.
Directional linear agreement under a separate lifecycle contract.
No correlation result is inferred from PID output.
Two-input local learning goal composed from named atoms.
An objective composition is not a PID definition or implementation route.
Role-distinct from the PNAS bivariate objective.
Outside this sample-estimator route. It does not define another PID.
Reference roles are typed separately across MGW, Williams–Beer, Schick-Poland, Ehrlich, KSG, and co-/O-information.
Page (1954) supplies only the sequential CUSUM foundation. Harder–Rauh–Lyu supply caveats. Two papers define objectives.
Full author teams, titles, locators, and role boundaries are serialized in the study. Citation adjacency never authorizes method substitution.
No PID value enters FusedVerdict or a Haldir decision. Galadriel 0.9.0 has no Haldir adapter, runtime edge, or policy effect.
